title: Drum styles, Red Happy, Bebe Matthews and Silver Leaf personnel
summary: Charles describes Carter's and Red Happy's drumming and the substitute drummers and banjoists of the Silver Leaf band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well what kind of drum style did Carter play? Would he play mostly on his snare drum for the whole number, or would he be making explosions everywhere, or would he? No.

No, he played the whole number with the exception, sometimes he used to play on a different instrument, you see. For instance, sometimes he worked just on the cymbal, you see what I mean? Other times he might work just on the tom-tom, you see? Other times he just on the bells, you see? It's all depending on the drummer you had that could even use those instruments. Because you say you take a fancy and they felt like the happy, you heard of him?
Which one? I know three of them. I knew three. You understand which one? Red Happy and Black Happy. Red Happy and Tom. Red Happy.

Well he was about the most sensational drummer we had. Because he could, I suppose that guy, if you had a hundred little things there, you could hit him at the same time. He was just that fast. He was the whirlwind. Oh my. I'm telling you.

Black Happy had a stroke, but he still, he can walk around some day, he gets out some, you know? Oh yeah, we have. You remember Black Happy, huh? He was another drummer too. Probably so. You'd know him if you saw him, Goldson. And then all the Matthews brothers, there was a happy among all the Matthews, you know Bill? Oh Bill I hope. Yeah. Well he had another brother, Bebe, and another one happy.

Bebe played the drum with us too. With which band? Not the trombone player. Bill is the trombone player. Yeah. But Bebe was the drummer. But Bebe played with us too, but not regular, you know? Which band though? Silver Leaf.
Silver Leaf. I see. So we're getting some of the guys to substitute him. Yeah that's right. Was Willie Santiago in there regular or is the substitute?
Oh he was regular, yeah. Yeah, after Nickerson quit. That's right.
Who did Nickerson play with after that? Well he went away. Oh he left? Yeah. I see.
